provenance.summary: Gated: serving anyone else's Instagram account needs Advanced Access, which requires both App Review and Business Verification, and end users must have a Business or Creator account. We tested the end-user side through Composio's managed app (it works today but shows "Composio-IG" to your users); the developer-side Meta portal run is still to come, so those steps are from Meta's docs.

accessLevels.name: Read the user's profile and media
accessLevels.mechanism: Instagram API with Instagram Login, user access token.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Agent estimate: app setup plus a testable app, screencast, test instructions and Business Verification documents.

evidence.label: reported
evidence.note: No official figure. 2026 reports: App Review grew from 1-3 days (2025) to 17-19 days (May 2026); Business Verification "in review" for 10+ days.

accessLevels.recommendation: Start Business Verification first, then App Review; test with your own accounts under Standard Access meanwhile.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: Advanced Access: "This access level requires App Review and Business Verification."

accessLevels.name: Publish posts (e.g. player cards)
accessLevels.mechanism: Content publishing endpoints with the user's token; images must be public JPEG URLs.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Agent estimate: as for reading, plus a working publish flow to record in the screencast.

evidence.label: reported
evidence.note: Reported 2026 waits of roughly 2-3 weeks per review round; rejections restart the clock.

accessLevels.recommendation: The long pole. Ship a share-sheet fallback (no OAuth) for posting while review is pending.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: Instagram Login publishing needs "instagram_business_basic, instagram_business_content_publish".

prerequisites.description: Each end user needs an Instagram Business or Creator (professional) account; personal accounts can't connect.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Only supports Instagram Business and Creator accounts, not Instagram Personal accounts." Also shown in the Composio dashboard during our test.

prerequisites.description: A business that can pass Meta Business Verification, attached to the app.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "You must complete Business Verification if your app requires Advanced Access"

prerequisites.description: A public privacy policy URL in the app settings.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: App settings require a "Privacy Policy URL".

prerequisites.description: Images to publish must be JPEGs on a publicly reachable URL at publish time.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "the media must be hosted on a publicly accessible server at the time of the attempt" and "JPEG is the only image format supported."

steps.title: Create a Meta app and add Instagram
steps.detail: In the Meta App Dashboard, create an app and add the Instagram product, choosing API setup with Instagram login.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: Path: App Dashboard > Instagram > API setup with Instagram login.

steps.title: Set Composio's callback as the OAuth redirect URI
steps.detail: Under Business login settings, add the redirect URI from your Composio INSTAGRAM auth config, character for character.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Make sure this exactly matches one of the base URIs in your list of valid OAuth URIs"; the Dashboard may add a trailing slash.

steps.title: Publish privacy policy and data-deletion pages
steps.detail: Draft the privacy policy (naming Meta data, Composio and AI processing) and a data-deletion page or callback, then add their URLs in app settings.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: Data deletion: Meta's basic settings mention both a callback and an instructions URL; which one Instagram review accepts is open.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config with your app's credentials
steps.detail: Create an INSTAGRAM auth config that uses your own Meta app (app ID and secret) and pass it to your sessions.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "an owned Meta app is the current unblock path for production usage."

steps.title: Test with your own accounts under Standard Access
steps.detail: Add your team's professional accounts to the app and connect them. Check which permissions each user actually granted: users can switch off everything except basic profile on the consent screen.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Permission toggles observed on Instagram's consent screen during our managed-app test (2026-10-28).

steps.title: Make a successful API call for each permission
steps.detail: Meta requires at least one successful call per permission before you can request Advanced Access; a coding agent can write and run these.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "To request Advanced Access to certain permissions, you need to make at least 1 successful API call"

steps.title: Complete Business Verification
steps.detail: Verify your business in Meta Business settings and connect it to the app. Start this first; it gates everything else.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "You must complete Business Verification if your app requires Advanced Access"

steps.title: Prepare screencasts and test instructions
steps.detail: Write a step-by-step use case and test login per permission; the agent scripts each screencast, you record it showing the end-to-end flow with the login button visible.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Upload a screencast showing the end-to-end user experience for that specific permission or feature."

steps.title: Submit App Review for Advanced Access
steps.detail: Submit each permission with its use case, screencast and test instructions; reviewers must be able to load and test the app externally.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Your app must complete App Review before it can request permissions with Advanced Access from any app user"

gates.name: Meta app with Instagram login
gates.description: Create the Meta app, add Instagram with Instagram login, and set the redirect URI.

gates.name: Privacy policy and data deletion
gates.description: A privacy policy URL and a data-deletion path are required in the app settings.

gates.name: App Review (Advanced Access)
gates.description: Meta reviews each permission's use case, screencast and test access before your app can serve accounts you don't own or manage.

evidence.label: reported
evidence.note: No official figure found. Reports range from days (2025) to 17-19 days (May 2026).

reviewerChecks.text: The app can be loaded and tested externally, with test login instructions.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Confirm that your app can be loaded and tested externally"

reviewerChecks.text: A screencast per permission showing the end-to-end user experience.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "Upload a screencast showing the end-to-end user experience for that specific permission or feature."

reviewerChecks.text: At least one successful API call per permission.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "you need to make at least 1 successful API call"

rejectionReasons.reason: Reviewers couldn't log in or reproduce the flow.
rejectionReasons.fix: Give working test credentials and step-by-step instructions that match the screencast.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Inferred from what Meta requires; no rejection statistics found.

gates.name: Business Verification
gates.description: Meta verifies the legal business behind the app; required for Advanced Access and for any user without a role on the app.

evidence.label: reported
evidence.note: Forum report of verification "in review" for 10+ days, blocking App Review submission (2026).

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "You must complete Business Verification if your app requires Advanced Access"

fallbackWhilePending.text: Use Composio's managed Instagram app: it connected a real account end to end in our test, but users see "Composio-IG" on Instagram's consent screen.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Tested 2026-10-28 with a real account.

fallbackWhilePending.text: Serve your own and your team's accounts under Standard Access, which needs no review.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "If your app only serves your Instagram professional account or an account you manage, Standard Access is all the your app needs."

fallbackWhilePending.text: For posting, render the image and hand it to the phone's share sheet; no OAuth or review needed.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Product suggestion, not a provider fact.

whyGoCustom.text: Branding: the managed app shows "Composio-IG" on Instagram's own consent screen, after Composio's connect page.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Observed 2026-10-28; consent screenshot (04) still to be added.

whyGoCustom.text: Some permissions (e.g. replying to comments) aren't approved on the managed app; Composio says an owned Meta app is the production path.

evidence.label: documented
evidence.note: "an owned Meta app is the current unblock path for production usage."

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Managed connection reached "In use" in the Composio dashboard.

redirectUri.text: Copy the exact callback from your Composio INSTAGRAM auth config.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Composio's Instagram page doesn't state the OAuth callback; read it off the auth config screen in the portal run.

notes.text: The managed app requested publish, messages, comments and insights permissions from our non-tester account, each of which the user can switch off; so check granted permissions before posting.
